name: Features and entitlements
takeaways: Features change billing; entitlements control access
Quantity and Credits are creatable; Feature is automatic

learn.intro: The word "feature" means two things here. Contract features change how a product is billed. Entitlements control what a customer may use.

cards.title: Payment terms
cards.body: Defines how the invoice due date is calculated.
cards.example: Net 30 on an invoice dated Mar 1 is due Mar 31.

cards.title: Discount
cards.body: Applies to a specific product within a particular phase.
cards.example: 10% off the API product in the second phase only.

cards.title: Commitment
cards.body: The minimum and maximum financial obligation a customer agrees to over the contract.

cards.title: Service fee
cards.body: An additional charge on top of standard product pricing.
cards.example: A 2% platform fee added on top of product charges (illustrative).

cards.title: Tax
cards.body: Tax rules, for example through Avalara, configured on the phase.
cards.example: Apply Avalara tax calculation to the Standard phase.

cards.title: Quantity
cards.example: 10,000 API calls granted; each call subtracts from the balance.

cards.title: Credit
cards.body: Controls how much value can be consumed, without being real currency.

cards.title: Feature
cards.body: Controls whether a capability is available at all.
cards.example: SSO on or off. Created automatically for boolean products.

learn.outro: Not cash. Entitlements are usage-rights bookkeeping and sit off the balance sheet. They are independent of how revenue is billed or recognized. On a customer, open the Entitlements tab to see grants and each grant's consumption log.

edgeCases: Cash refunds. Refunding cash against an entitlement can create accounting discrepancies, because Zenskar does not reconcile entitlements with financial transactions.
Entitlements you did not create. For certain simple products Zenskar creates a matching entitlement automatically when the product is created.
Feature entitlements. You cannot create one from the Entitlements page today; only Quantity and Credits.
Validity. Free units and other entitlements inherit their validity from the pricing model or contract phase, so they end when the phase ends.
Missing sidebar item. The Entitlements module and Free Units are tied to the earlier contract experience. If the sidebar item is missing, check which experience the organization uses.
App only. Entitlements, free units and customer grants are configured through the app, not the API.

quiz.question: Which contract feature controls how an invoice due date is calculated?
quiz.explanation: Payment terms define when payment is due after an invoice is issued.

quiz.question: "Customers on the Enterprise plan get SSO; others do not." Which entitlement type is this?
quiz.explanation: Feature entitlements control whether a capability is available at all.

quiz.question: A customer is granted 500 credits. What are they?
quiz.explanation: Credit entitlements track how much value can be consumed without representing real currency.

quiz.question: What is the risk of issuing a cash refund against an entitlement?
options: Accounting discrepancies, since entitlements are off-balance-sheet
quiz.explanation: Zenskar does not reconcile entitlements with financial transactions.

quiz.question: Which entitlement types can you create from the Entitlements page?
quiz.explanation: Feature entitlements exist under the hood (for example for boolean products) but have no creation flow today.

qa.question: Contract feature vs feature entitlement?
qa.answer: A contract feature is a commercial setting (discount, tax, payment terms). A feature entitlement is an access switch.

qa.question: Quantity vs credit vs feature entitlement?
qa.answer: How much can be consumed, how much value can be consumed, and whether a capability is available.

qa.question: Entitlement vs product?
qa.answer: A product is what you bill. An entitlement is the right to use something, possibly linked to a product.

qa.question: Commitment vs entitlement?
qa.answer: Commitment is a financial minimum or maximum. An entitlement is a usage right.

qa.question: Discount vs service fee?
qa.answer: A discount reduces a product's charge in a phase. A service fee adds a charge on top.

qa.question: Grant vs balance?
qa.answer: A grant is what was given to a customer. The balance is what remains after consumption.

qa.question: Free units vs entitlements?
qa.answer: Both are tied to the earlier contract experience. Free units are included usage on a product; entitlements record usage rights per customer. Confirm details with an SME.

qa.question: Payment terms vs invoice date?
qa.answer: Payment terms set the due date. The invoice date comes from the date rule.

qa.question: Include 10,000 API calls per month?
qa.answer: A quantity entitlement granted to the customer.

qa.question: Promotional credits?
qa.answer: A credit entitlement.

qa.question: SSO only for enterprise?
qa.answer: A feature entitlement.

qa.question: Discount in the second phase only?
qa.answer: A discount feature on that product in that phase.

qa.question: Guarantee a minimum spend?
qa.answer: A commitment feature over the contract duration.

qa.question: Cash refunds for an entitlement?
qa.answer: Can create accounting discrepancies because entitlements are off-balance-sheet.

qa.question: Entitlement appeared without you creating it?
qa.answer: Zenskar creates one automatically for certain simple products.

qa.question: Can I create a feature entitlement on the Entitlements page?
qa.answer: No, only quantity and credits.

qa.question: When does an entitlement expire?
qa.answer: Its validity follows the pricing model or contract phase, and a grant can carry an expiry.

qa.question: Entitlements missing from the sidebar?
qa.answer: They belong to the earlier contract experience.

qa.question: Where do I see usage of a grant?
qa.answer: Customer, Entitlements tab, then open the grant's consumption log.

qa.question: Do entitlements affect revenue recognition?
qa.answer: No.
